title: IngestResult
description: The one shape every jt connector returns: the content of ingested material as ordered blocks, plus a non-optional record of exactly where that material came from, and any warnings raised on the way in.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this result's schema (semver: major.minor.patch).

blocks.description: The content, in reading order. May be empty only when the input had no extractable text, in which case a warning says so.

text.description: The text of this block. Never empty.

index.description: Zero-based position of this block in the ingested material.

kind.description: What kind of block this is.

locator.description: Where in the source this block came from, when the source has addressable structure, e.g. 'page:3' for a PDF page or 'h2' for a heading level.

provenance.description: Where the content came from. Non-optional: nothing enters jt as a stripped file.

sourceKind.description: What kind of material this came from.

uri.description: Where the material came from, when it has an address (URL or file path).

name.description: The material's own name (usually a file name), when it has one.

contentDigest.description: Cryptographic digest of the exact input bytes, as 'sha256:<hex>'. Same input, same digest.

byteSize.description: Size of the exact input in bytes.

title.description: Title of the material, when one could be determined.

pageCount.description: Number of pages, for paged material such as PDF.

warnings.description: Anything that went wrong or was lossy on the way in. Empty when ingestion was clean.
